description_en: Invoke this API to perform a paged query of the group list
description_zh: 调用该接口分页查询分组列表
kebab_example: aliyun iot query-device-group-list --iot-instance-id iot_instc_pu0000_c0-v6400000000 --page-size 10 --super-group-id 8vDubXr4nUvZkNgk9mle010200 --group-name GroupName1 --current-page 1 --group-types example-string --api-version 2018-01-20 --region cn-hangzhou
name: QueryDeviceGroupList

parameters.description_en:
The ID of the instance. You can view the instance **ID** on the **Overview** page in the IoT Platform console.

>*   If your instance has an ID, you must configure this parameter. If you do not set this parameter, the call fails.
>*   If your instance has no **Overview** page or ID, you do not need to set this parameter.

For more information, see [Overview](~~356505~~).

parameters.description_en: The ID of the parent group. If you need to query the subgroups of a parent group, specify this parameter.
parameters.description_zh: 父组ID。查询某父组下的子分组列表时，需传入此参数。
parameters.help_en: The ID of the parent group. If you need to query the subgroups of a parent group, specify this parameter
parameters.help_zh: 父组ID。查询某父组下的子分组列表时，需传入此参数
parameters.name: super_group_id

parameters.description_en:
The name of the group.

*   If you specify this parameter, the system queries groups by group name. You can perform a fuzzy search by group name.
*   If you do not specify this parameter, the system queries all groups.
parameters.description_zh:
分组名称。

- 传入分组名称，则根据名称进行查询。不支持分组名称模糊查询。
- 若不传入此参数，则进行全量分组查询。

parameters.description_en: The number of the page to return. Default value: 1.
parameters.description_zh: 指定从返回结果中的第几页开始显示。默认值为1。

parameters.description_en:
The type of groups to query.

Currently, only one value is supported: **LINK_PLATFORM_DYNAMIC**, which indicates a dynamic group. If this parameter is not specified, static groups are queried by default.
parameters.description_zh:
待查询的分组类型。

目前仅支持传入一个，且为**LINK_PLATFORM_DYNAMIC**，表示动态分组。不传入时，默认为静态分组。
